mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_offering o LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=o.course_id WHERE ()

SELECT o.id AS offeringId, o.display_name AS displayName, c.course_code AS courseCode, o.activity_type AS activityType, o.class_group_text AS classGroupText, o.student_count AS studentCount, sem.id AS semesterId, sem.semester_code AS semesterCode, sem.semester_name AS semesterName, o.source_scope_college_id AS sourceScopeCollegeId, owner_college.id AS ownerCollegeId, owner_college.college_code AS ownerCollegeCode, owner_college.college_name AS ownerCollegeName, c.syllabus_ref AS syllabusRef FROM course_offering o LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=o.course_id LEFT JOIN college owner_college ON owner_college.id=c.owner_college_id JOIN semester sem ON sem.id=o.semester_id WHERE ()
ORDER BY o.display_name ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id AS offeringId, o.display_name AS displayName, c.id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_code AS courseCode, c.syllabus_ref AS syllabusRef, c.description AS description, o.activity_type AS activityType, o.class_group_text AS classGroupText, o.student_count AS studentCount, sem.id AS semesterId, sem.semester_code AS semesterCode, sem.semester_name AS semesterName, sem.first_week_date AS firstWeekDate, source_college.id AS sourceScopeCollegeId, source_college.college_code AS sourceScopeCollegeCode, source_college.college_name AS sourceScopeCollegeName, owner_college.id AS ownerCollegeId, owner_college.college_code AS ownerCollegeCode, owner_college.college_name AS ownerCollegeName FROM course_offering o JOIN semester sem ON sem.id=o.semester_id JOIN college source_college ON source_college.id=o.source_scope_college_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=o.course_id LEFT JOIN college owner_college ON owner_college.id=c.owner_college_id WHERE () AND o.id=#{offeringId}

SELECT schedule.id AS scheduleId, schedule.weekday, schedule.start_section AS startSection, schedule.end_section AS endSection, schedule.raw_week_text AS rawWeekText, location.id AS locationId, location.display_name AS locationDisplayName, location.location_group AS locationGroup, location.location_type AS locationType FROM class_schedule schedule JOIN location ON location.id=schedule.location_id WHERE schedule.offering_id=#{offeringId} ORDER BY schedule.weekday ASC, schedule.start_section ASC, schedule.end_section ASC, schedule.id ASC
